description: This file defines the NNCrypto class implementing cryptographic operations such as encryption, decryption, key derivation, and streaming, utilizing the Sodium library and related modules within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: NNCrypto
classes.description: Implements cryptographic functions such as encryption, decryption, key management, and streaming for the Notesnook project.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Sodium library asynchronously if not already initialized.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input data with a serialized key and specified data format, returning a ciphertext.

methods.name: encryptMulti
methods.description: Encrypts multiple data items with a serialized key.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts ciphertext data with a serialized key, returning the original output.

methods.name: decryptMulti
methods.description: Decrypts multiple ciphertext items with a serialized key.

methods.name: decryptAsymmetric
methods.description: Performs asymmetric decryption using a key pair.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Generates a hash from a password and salt.

methods.name: deriveKey
methods.description: Derives an encryption key from a password and optional salt.

methods.name: exportKey
methods.description: Exports a serialized key from a password and optional salt.

methods.name: createEncryptionStream
methods.description: Creates an encryption stream with a serialized key.

methods.name: createDecryptionStream
methods.description: Creates a decryption stream with a serialized key and IV.
